title: NestJS modules of ota/backend/src
caption: One folder per module under ota/backend/src. Arrows are module dependencies (who calls whom); only amadeus, payments, notifications and documents talk to the outside. Source: ota/docs/architecture.md §2 and the module files.

nodes.label: common
nodes.detail: `src/common`: guards (caller, tenant, scope, customer, staff, booking access, CSRF, permission), OpenAPI validation and idempotency interceptors, error filter, cookie writer, Redis keys (`redis.keys.ts`), queue names, Clock, ids.

nodes.label: tenancy
nodes.detail: `src/tenancy`: caller and tenant resolution (edge, `pk_`/`sk_` keys, service key), read-only platform repository + 60 s Redis caches, `vx:invalidate` subscriber, `TenantContext`, `tenantTx`.

nodes.label: identity
nodes.detail: `src/identity`: customer sign-up, verification, sign-in, sessions (cookie and bearer), password reset, JWT keys; `identity/staff`: console sign-in by portal token, staff sessions in Redis.

nodes.label: account
nodes.detail: `src/account`: profile, deletion, and the worker's hourly erasure (`customers.erase`).

nodes.label: storefront
nodes.detail: `src/storefront`: `storefront.get`, published content pages (Markdown subset → blocks), public images.

nodes.label: reference
nodes.detail: `src/reference`: locations, airports, airlines, countries, currencies from the `reference` schema.

nodes.label: shopping
nodes.detail: `src/shopping`: searches, results with facets, offers, upsell, priced offers, ancillaries, fare rules, offers purge.

nodes.label: pricing
nodes.detail: `src/pricing`: markup and fee engine (`pricing-engine.ts`, `rule-matcher.ts`), card fees; decimal.js money.

nodes.label: checkout
nodes.detail: `src/checkout`: checkout aggregate (travellers with encrypted documents, contacts, ancillaries, remarks), totals, expiry job.

nodes.label: payments
nodes.detail: `src/payments`: `PaymentGateway` (Stripe in three account modes, airline card), payments and refunds, webhooks, Stripe events, capture/void/refund jobs, authorisation watch.

nodes.label: bookings
nodes.detail: `src/bookings`: orchestration (claim → order → record → money → issue), ticketing, sync, reconciliation, change and cancel, my bookings, guest lookup.

nodes.label: documents
nodes.detail: `src/documents`: itinerary and e-ticket receipt PDFs (pdfmake), signed download URLs, `/v1/files/*`.

nodes.label: notifications
nodes.detail: `src/notifications`: outbox, templates (tenant rows or code defaults), renderer, SMTP mailer, staff recipients.

nodes.label: amadeus
nodes.detail: `src/amadeus`: the only Amadeus caller: connection resolver, token provider, rate limiter, call context, error mapper, `supplier_requests` log.

nodes.label: console
nodes.detail: `src/console`: console bookings, PNR lookup/import, queues, customers, supplier log, raw Amadeus reads, payments; `staff_actions` writer; review closure; queue poller.

nodes.label: settings
nodes.detail: `src/settings`: markup and fee rules, storefront settings, pages, asset uploads, notification templates.

nodes.label: provisioning
nodes.detail: `src/provisioning`: `ota-tenant-ops` consumer (provision, migrate, suspend, resume), seeds, `platform-tenant-events` producer, failure classifier.

nodes.label: jobs
nodes.detail: `src/jobs`: schedulers (`OTA_SCHEDULES`), per-tenant fan-out on `ota-maintenance`, retention purges.

nodes.label: health
nodes.detail: `src/health`: `/health/live`, `/health/ready` (postgres, redis; the worker's adds queue ages).
